objective: Release the Plagueland Termites in the Northridge Lumber Mill, then return with the Barrel of Plagueland Termites to Mickey Levine at the Bulwark in Tirisfal Glades.

description: You look around the lumber mill for something suitable to open the barrel with. You find a crowbar that looks like it will do the trick.
You set your feet and pray that you'll be able to get out of the mill before the termites get to you.
progress: Have you done it, <name>? Have you released the termites in the lumber mill?
It was bad enough that my family lost their jobs and lives, but then to see the place where my childhood was spent taken over by those disgusting so-called holy men... pfah!!
completion: Thank you, <name>. Here, take this coin. I'm sorry it's not more, but try to take some joy in helping destroy the Scarlet Crusade's efforts!
